name: stead_60km

origin.note: illustrative valley-floor point, not an observatory location

encoding: terrarium: elevation_m = R*256 + G + B/256 - 32768 (quantised to 1/4 m); alpha 255
layout: row 0 = north edge, column 0 = west edge; pixel centres at east = -size/2 + (i+0.5)*cell, north = size/2 - (j+0.5)*cell
projection: local equirectangular about the origin (east = dlon * m_per_deg_lon, north = dlat * m_per_deg_lat)
attribution: Elevation: Terrain Tiles (Mapzen / Linux Foundation) via the AWS Open Data Registry, https://registry.opendata.aws/terrain-tiles/ . Contains data from USGS 3DEP (3D Elevation Program, public domain) and other sources credited at https://github.com/tilezen/joerd/blob/master/docs/attribution.md
